panels.description: Late afternoon on Keel’s pit rim. Keel lies in shadow, Halyard catches gold and Oasis remains in sunlight. A dry fountain stands nearby as Ada approaches with two battered mugs. Leave upper-left clear.
Ada offers Alex a mug, her ration card visible at her hip. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Close on the ration card, Ada’s hand and Alex’s hands around the mugs. Keep four distinct lettering zones.
Alex and Ada sit side by side on the railing, laughing briefly. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear for one balloon each.
Ada watches Alex while he looks away, his frustration over Site 6’s credit visible in his clenched posture. Reserve upper-left for Ada and lower-left for Alex.

Alex looks upward toward Oasis while Ada looks down toward Keel, wind lifting her copper hair. Reserve a clean upper-left zone for Alex and a clean lower-right zone for Ada. No other dialogue balloons.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The birthday special? Not sure I can afford it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Where'd you get enough water for two?

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Not everything has a price, Alex.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Everyone did. My bracket's in the Site 6 catalog now. Their name on it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: I look up there and wonder what it feels like to choose your own future.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: I look down here and wonder why people stopped trying to change it.
